pages.text: Outposts are occupied pieces of Ogre territory built around a captain and guarded tribute.$(br2)Plains and Swamp Outposts share the same possible leaders: Grunt Captain, Brute, or Mage. Their layout and surroundings differ, but opening their tribute is understood as theft by the entire Tribe.

pages.title: A Route to the Fort
pages.text: The tribute at a Plains Outpost reliably yields a Fort Map. Swamp Outposts may also hold one, but are not the guaranteed route.
An Outpost introduces both the Tribe's memory and its larger ambitions.
